_review: Frost, after the release (docs/gameplay-design.md §7 'Restored world'): Varo, who watched the Warden for three years, now watches the wind, and sends the Wraith to the Shelf. The summit course is systems/restored/summit.js (rings and streams in data/restored.json; medals there too: tests/restored.test.js pins that the steps below ask for the same seconds). Merged after frost.json (systems/chapter.js mergeChapters: talkFirst/barksFirst go in front of the old tables). Dialogue follows docs/village/dialogue-style.md.
title: First Snow

lines: The pennant on my rise points the same way as the one on the Shelf. I check it before I check the sky.
Go in the morning. The wind is steadier before the sun is high.

varo.wind.speaker: varo
lines: I have been watching the Shelf, the ridge above the monastery. The snow streams off its edge like smoke.
The wind climbs the face under it. I stood there this morning and my cloak lifted off my shoulders.
Your robe will do more than that. Go to the cairn on the Shelf, run off the edge and open the robe. Six rings hang over the bowl.
You cannot reach them all by gliding down. Climb the face to get your height back. A gust lifts harder than a lull.

varo.wind.wait.speaker: varo
lines: The cairn is on the Shelf, east of the monastery. Climb the face in the wind, and bank your height before the long glide.

varo.wind.bronze.speaker: varo
lines: I watched from the Rise. You went up the face like smoke, and you came down through every ring.
It can be faster. Wait for a gust before you start climbing, and leave the face the moment you have the height.

varo.wind.silver.speaker: varo
lines: I watched from the Rise. You did not waste a breath of it.
Gold is a few seconds more. Take the last glide at full speed, and dive.

varo.wind.gold.speaker: varo
lines: I counted it twice. Nobody should fly that fast.
I will hang a pennant on the Rise, so I can see what you saw. Thank you for waking the wind.

varo.wind.after.speaker: varo
lines: The wind comes through the Shelf every morning now. I used to stand and wait for nothing. This is better.

lore-shelf.title: The Shelf
lore-shelf.text: A ridge above the monastery where the snow streams off the edge. The Shapers' pilgrims called the air under it the stair: the wind climbs the face, and anything that spreads its cloak in it climbs too. As told by Varo.

quests.title: The Shelf Stream
quests.summary: Varo has watched the wind climb the ridge above the monastery. He thinks a robe could ride it.

steps.journal: Talk to Varo at his rise, above the camp.
Go to the Shelf, the ridge east of the monastery. A cairn with a pennant stands on its edge.
Fly all six rings from the Shelf. Run off the edge and open the robe. The wind climbs the face under the ridge: ride it to get your height back. The robe needs the wind, so wait for the gusts.
Fly the rings in under 130 seconds. Leave the face as soon as you have the height.
Fly the rings in under 100 seconds. Time the climb to a gust, and dive on the last glide.
